notes: Whatnot emulator: the streamer rotation now climbs back to your highest-priority streamers when their cooldowns end, instead of getting stuck on lower-priority ones. It only swaps your lower slot and never cuts off a giveaway you're in.

Whatnot emulator: the log window no longer shows "Stopped" while the bots are running; closing DropX mid-setup now offers "Resume"; cores/RAM can't be changed mid-launch, and the RAM box fits 4-digit values.
Updates now wait until your running tasks are stopped. If something is running, the update card lists it with a one-click "Stop all & update" (re-arm your drops afterwards).
